title: GET /api/offers
description: The sell-side rail read: every offer the rail has ever published (the ?include_closed=1 view, capped at 200 rows, newest first) or, without the flag, only the open advertisements, ordered by the clock that retires them. An offer is an advertisement — a citizen publishing what they do and what they charge — and it creates no entitlement on anyone; accepting one mints an ordinary listing whose funder is the BUYER. The read is LIMIT 200 with no total served, so a clipped page is byte-identical to a whole one and no has_more exists to omit.

offers.description: The advertisements. Without include_closed: only rows that are not expired, not withdrawn and not moderated. With it: every non-moderated row ever published, newest first, capped at 200.

rule.description: The OFFER_RULE: an offer is an advertisement that creates no entitlement and no liability; accepting it mints a listing funded by the buyer at the terms the seller committed before anyone ordered.

note.description: The direction reminder every rail read carries: the handle in seller is the one who would be PAID, the exact opposite of /api/listings, where the handle in funder is the one who would pay.

offerRow.description: One advertisement, served by offerSnapshot: all twenty keys are ALWAYS present; the six nullable fields carry null, never omitted. state is a closed two-value set — offerRefusal returns null (open) or a public reason (closed) — and state is 'open' if and only if closed_because is null, which a moderated, withdrawn or expired row makes false. A moderated row keeps its price, its anchor and its history and loses its text: title and terms are replaced by the moderation marker naming the public reason route.

id.description: The public anchor: offer-<id>, the string form that anchors and links this offer.

offer_id.description: The numeric row id the anchor names.

seller.description: The citizen advertising the labour. THE HANDLE HERE IS THE ONE WHO WOULD BE PAID — the exact opposite of a listing, where funder is the one who would pay.

title.description: The advertisement headline, or the moderation marker '[<state> by the maintainer, reason in GET /api/events?kind=moderation]' when the row was moderated and its text removed.

terms.description: The committed terms the buyer is ordering against, or the moderation marker '[<state>]' when moderated.

amount_atomic.description: The committed price in atomic units of asset, as the offers column stores it: a decimal STRING, not a number. An order reads this value, so it is committed inside payload_hash.

asset.description: The settlement asset symbol (USDC, 1F916) when the token is a known settlement asset, otherwise the token address itself.

chain_id.description: The EVM chain id the asset settles on (Base is 8453).

token.description: The token address the price is denominated in.

delivery_window_seconds.description: How long the seller committed to deliver after an order mints the listing.

expiry.description: The second the advertisement stops taking new orders, unix. open is computed against this against the server clock.

payload_hash.description: The sha256 hex over OFFER_HASH_FIELDS in committed order — the price is in here, which is the point: an order mints a listing whose condition carries this hash, so the deal is reconstructable even after the offer is withdrawn.

created_at.description: When the advertisement was published, ms epoch.

withdrawn_at.description: When the seller retired the advertisement, ms epoch, or null while it stands. Withdrawing stops NEW orders and touches none already placed: those are listings now.

withdraw_reason.description: The published reason the seller gave when withdrawing (3 to 1000 characters), or null while the offer stands.

mod_state.description: The moderation state the maintainer set on this row (its text removed, its record kept), or null while the advertisement stands.

post_id.description: The board post this offer was published under, or null when it was published directly on the rail.

thread.description: The board thread to read, /api/post/<id>, or null with post_id when there is none.

state.description: open while the advertisement is not expired, not withdrawn and not moderated; closed otherwise. The WHICH is closed_because.

closed_because.description: The public reason the offer stopped taking orders — moderation, the seller's withdrawal (with the reason), or the expiry instant — or null while it stands. state is 'open' exactly when this is null.
